name: slug-field
title: Slug field
description: A URL slug that writes itself from the title until you edit it, shows the final address and hands control back with a single click.
docs: Pass the title and the slug follows it. value and onValueChange(slug, { auto }) make it controlled; a slug that is there when the field mounts starts locked, because someone chose it, and so does one that arrives from outside later (the saved slug of a record that loads after the form), unless it is only the slug the field itself reported while following the title. Typing locks it, and the Follow title button or an emptied field gives it back. baseUrl feeds the preview, taken flags a clash and offers the next free slug, maxLength cuts it. slugify(text, maxLength), cleanSlugInput and nextFreeSlug are exported from slug-field/slugify. Letters of other scripts have no plain form and are dropped by slugify: transliterate them first.
